title: Gertrude Bell's birth chart
metaDescription: Gertrude Bell's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 22.2° Cancer. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Four of the ten placements whose signs are settled stand in Cancer — the Sun, Mercury, Venus and Uranus. The placements whose signs could change with an unknown hour are not counted. A cluster that size becomes the section the rest of the chart plays around.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: At noon on that date the Sun stood at 22.2° Cancer, inside the third decan (20°–30°), whose traditional sub-ruler is Jupiter. The decan is the older, finer division — it is what the sign looks like once you stop rounding it to thirty degrees.

blocks.title: The personal registers
blocks.text: Day to day the chart speaks through Mercury in Cancer (22.2°), Venus in Cancer (25.8°), Mars in Gemini (9.1°): thought steeped in tone and memory, attraction that works by atmosphere, effort aimed through strategy and words.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Closest first: the Sun to Mercury, a conjunction with 0.0° of slack. When two functions occupy one degree, the tradition reads a fusion: neither can act without committing the other. Behind it, Jupiter square Uranus at 0.1°, and Uranus sextile Pluto at 3.2° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. The unknown hour cannot unmake any of this: every aspect named survived all twenty-five samples of the day.

blocks.title: The standing structure
blocks.text: The Moon makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Read against the old dignities, one placement stands out. The Moon in Taurus at 9.8° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best. None of this ranks anyone; dignity describes footing, and footing can be worked with.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Among the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, the elements divide 5 water, 2 earth, 2 fire, 1 air; by modality, 6 cardinal, 3 fixed, 1 mutable. Water weights a chart toward the felt and the remembered — information that arrives as atmosphere before it arrives as words. Mercury, Venus and Saturn were retrograde — the backward drift a body appears to make as the Earth overtakes it, read in the scheme as a function that reviews before it releases.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Taurus for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 13.2° between midnight and midnight. Fast enough that its degree is approximate, slow enough that its sign is not in doubt. At the noon reference it stands at 9.8°.
